title: Contemporary Records and Lester Koenig's lack of promotion
summary: Humes loved Contemporary and Mr. Koenig but says he never pushed the records beyond sending copies to disc jockeys. She thinks they were her best work; Nat Hentoff and Koenig wrote notes, and Previn, Marty Paich and Wynton Kelly played.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
